Hi Lara —

Thanks for the clear ask. Below is the short checklist procurement can attach to the PO. I kept it focused so your finance team can drop it into your routing system. Happy to hop on a call if you want to walk through anything.

Redwood vendor activation checklist (for marketplace listing PO lane)
1) Legal/Tax paperwork (send with PO where possible):
   - U.S. customers: completed W-9 (PDF)
   - EU customers: VAT registration certificate + local tax form where applicable
   - If non-U.S./EU, provide local tax ID and WHT guidance
2) Security & compliance evidence:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide redacted copy) — acceptable post-PO in most cases; if your security team requires pre-PO review, we can provide a read-only link and NDA.
   - Data processing addendum (DPA) — included in our standard SOW or via separate signature if you prefer
3) Commercial docs:
   - Signed SOW via DocuSign OR PO (either works). For most marketplace activations we accept PO+Signed T&Cs and proceed; if your legal requires a signed SOW first, we can generate one quickly.
   - Standard payment terms: net 30 by default (Net 45/60 available on request — route to finance@redwood.ai for credit review).
   - Billing contact: finance@redwood.ai (cc: billing ops team)
4) Marketplace-specific items:
   - Marketplace listing requires merchant onboarding form (link below) and a merchant contact for technical integration (we require a cloud account owner and an SRE contact).
   - If you plan to use AWS GovCloud or Azure Government, flag that in the PO so we allocate the right private deployment path.

Practical next steps we recommend:
- You can attach the W-9 and PO to the intake form here: https://docs.redwood.ai/vendor-intake/form/meridian-2026
- If you want a signed SOW first I attached a short draft (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and a pricing sheet you already sent — we can finalize the SOW and send a DocuSign link.
- Routing: send PO to finance@redwood.ai. If invoice required to list a purchase order #, include the marketplace listing ID in the PO notes.

I cc'd Vanessa (marketplace ops) and Ben (payments) to confirm the PO lane and whether any extra fields are needed on the PO for marketplace accounting.

Thanks,

- Finance: PO should include 'Marketplace Listing' in the line-item description and the external listing ID when available. That prevents manual remapping.
